outro.rule: Colden 2026-10-01: 'use the colden ending on all'. Measured template: edit-clips references/end_screen.md (30 fps frames, converted by time at other rates).

rules.23: camera change > b-roll > 1.25x eye-pivot punch; never a jump cut
rules.24: trims allowed only where hidden; a swear is never trimmed, it is beeped and ducked
rules.30: the hook plays again in context (it is not removed from the body)
rules.32: cold open 12-15 s: "Hook running 17s... could easily condense to 12-15s" (Colden 2026-10-01, pilot note)
rules.33: b-roll is part of every v1: "you should include b-roll into V1's moving forward. That way I can give all notes at the same time."

swear_stems_note: a word CONTAINING a stem is a swear (fuckin, bullshit, horseshit, dipshit, clusterfuck, motherfucker, bitchy); `swear_not` lists look-alikes that are not; `swears` stays the exact list for short words (dick, pussy) that would over-match as stems

beep.why: Colden 2026-10-02: "Censors are missing the censor beep from power bin" -> the Power Bin beep is Short Censor Beep.wav (0.1 s, 1 kHz, steady, no fades): copies back to back cover the word

censor.why: Colden 2026-10-02: "let the first 3 frames of the waveform/word through. Then beep/duck. Then end the beep duck 3 frames before the end of the waveform/word". The word START is read from the program waveform (silence -> sound within +-3 frames of Whisper; Whisper edges are off by up to 100 ms); a word too short for 3 + 3 + a 3-frame beep gets ONE beep of min_beep frames centred on it (told to Colden, his call to change).
